title: ur-ws close 1 of 2: W1, W2, W4

calls.question: W1's test fixtures leave their sleep children running for up to 30 seconds. Land as is, or send a follow-up?

options.label: Land as is and file the cleanup
options.consequence: The test passes and exits 0. A pipe on its output waits for the leftover sleeps, up to 30 seconds.

options.label: Send a follow-up that kills the children another way
options.consequence: W1 is held and a follow-up pass writes the cleanup, since the round rules bar a session from running pkill.

evidence.text: The fix is pkill -P on the fixture's sleeper before the kill. No verdict reads the leftover processes as a hit.

calls.question: W4 removes the hand check from standing answer 6, but claude-worktree-busy still counts the calling session's own row. Approve as written?

options.label: Approve as written and run backlog #75 before the next round with a conductor
options.consequence: The next conductor that checks the main checkout would end its launches at the first busy check until #75 lands.

options.label: Send back and keep a clause for the conductor's row until #75 lands
options.consequence: W4 is held, its executor is relaunched with your note, and the packet is resent.

evidence.text: Call 1 of the PR: the busy check still counts the caller's row, backlog #75.

calls.question: Three run details did not fit round-run.md under its 1,500-word cap. Take them later as backlog #78, or add them now?

options.label: Approve and take #78 later
options.consequence: The clock's count for answer 7, the report file's place, and a relaunched conductor's resume steps stay out of round-run.md for now.

options.label: Send back, raise the cap, and add them now
options.consequence: W4 is held and the 1,500-word cap on round-run.md changes, which your approved design fixed.

evidence.text: round-run.md is 1,499 words against the cap of 1,500. This is the one review finding left open.

steps.text: Merge the three PRs in order with approval-queue merge and pull ~/.dotfiles with git pull --ff-only. No stow and no tooling apply: no pass adds a script or changes a setting.
Send the second close packet for W5 and W3.

notChecked.text: None of the three PRs runs CI: the repo has no PR test CI, so the gate each executor ran is the only check.

reviews.text: W1: whole-branch review accept, one finding left open (the sleep children).
W2: whole-branch review accept, no open finding.
W4: whole-branch review accept, one finding left open (the three run details, #78).
